description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 109 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Bornes de recharge électrique dans le communauté d'agglomération Arden; Eolienne dans la Manche; Éolienne construite ou en projet dans la Manche; Ouvrages d'amenée de concessions hydroélectriques en Provence Alpes Cô. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
